description: Target-free propositional skeletons and evaluation at 90 and 15 CPU seconds. oursNNN is a native seed; sgcdN is a deterministic replicate. The _15 suffix denotes the shorter growth budget. Each bank uses its own node IDs. Each external proof graph also has its own node IDs. A pair [major,minor] denotes condensed detachment with fresh variables and a most-general unifier. Formula prefix syntax: i = implication, n = negation, integer followed by a period = schematic variable. Per-proof arrays follow bank_order. steps_saved counts distinct removed inferences within the proof, always retaining its final inference. The reference graphs use the same three axiom IDs (0,1,2).
